activity_summary: Heminges named your share as six-and-thirty shillings, against forty last Saturday, the spring's best. You said the chest was not counted. The sheet carried the share and not the lease. He was gloomy about a second Hercules yesterday, and he named no sum for that house. Pope and Phillips went home. You went toward the Jackdaw with the pouch tied.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said six-and-thirty back, and left the chest uncounted.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named the share, kept the lease off the sheet, and named no Rose sum.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Took the sum, refused an average, and went home.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Took six-and-thirty without asking it to be forty, and went home.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Took the silver and turned them toward the Jackdaw.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: The book is shut on six-and-thirty.
